notes.title: Community Update – Feedback & Roadmap Plans
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]It has been a little over a month since we released [b]Update 3[/b] for [i]Oil Refinery: The Simulation[/i]. While sales and direct feedback via email, Discord, and Steam discussions have been [b]overwhelmingly positive[/b], we’ve noticed a significant mismatch with the [b]current Steam reviews, which have dropped significantly.[/b][/p][p]We want to address this directly:[/p][h3][b]Tutorial Feedback[/b][/h3][p]Some reviews mention a lack of tutorial, which surprises us because the game [b]already includes an extended tutorial[/b] to explain the refinery’s systems and mechanics. If you have suggestions on how we can make it clearer or more helpful, please let us know - we are listening.[/p][h3][b]Gameplay Approach[/b][/h3][p]We understand that [i]Oil Refinery: The Simulation[/i] offers a [b]more realistic and technical experience[/b], which might feel less “casual” or “entertaining” compared to other simulators. This is intentional, as we aimed to deliver a game focused on [b]authentic refinery processes[/b] rather than arcade-style gameplay.[/p][h3][b]Roadmap Update[/b][/h3][p]While we have been actively fixing bugs and adding quality-of-life features with every update, we have decided to [b]put Update 4 (Market Forces) on hold[/b] for now. We want to evaluate the current state of the game, listen to your feedback, and ensure we are heading in the right direction before moving forward.[/p][h3][b]Your Feedback Matters[/b][/h3][p]The contrast between [b]strong sales and positive direct feedback[/b] vs. [b]low public reviews[/b] is confusing for us. We’d love to hear your suggestions on how we can bridge this gap. What improvements would you like to see? What would help you (and new players) enjoy the game more?[/p][p]Please share your thoughts in the comments or on our Discord. Your input is critical in shaping the future of [i]Oil Refinery: The Simulation[/i].[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and for helping us make this game the best it can be.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3 - New Vehicle Physics + Harbor Location
notes.content:
[p]We’ve just released [b]Update 3[/b] for [i]Oil Refinery: The Simulation[/i], bringing two major additions to the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577171/5169600bb12ef292cab7fe8f2c36f4d9f3cae9f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🚛 [b]New Vehicle with Improved Physics[/b]
A new, smaller transport vehicle has been added, featuring completely reworked driving physics for smoother and more predictable handling. Existing vehicles still use the original system - this allows you to compare both and let us know which version you prefer. Your feedback will help shape the future of all vehicle handling in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]⚓ [b]New Harbor Location[/b]
We've expanded the game world with a brand-new Harbor area! Some delivery destinations have been relocated there to integrate this new location into your workflow. Expect the Harbor to become even more important in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577171/38752ad65c23a3aa641e2ab43f9c8765809d582b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💰 [b]Looking Ahead: Update 4 – Market Forces[/b]
Next up, we’ll be focusing on the economy system. Update 4 will introduce dynamic pricing and more player choice, making locations like the Harbor play a bigger strategic role.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ [b]Known Issue[/b]
The new vehicle may display a visual glitch with the rear wheels on some systems. This does not affect gameplay and does not occur universally, but we are aware of the issue and working on a fix.
[/p][p]
Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for the upcoming update![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 – New Tutorial Available Now!
notes.content:
We’ve just released Update 1.2.0, featuring a brand-new tutorial for Oil Refinery – The Simulation! The tutorial now starts automatically the next time you launch the game and must be completed once. After that, you can replay it anytime from the main menu.

This update is based entirely on your feedback - thank you!
Now we want to hear more:
[list]
[*]How do you like the new tutorial?
[*]What would you like to see added or improved in the next update?
[/list]

Let us know in the comments!
